name: golden-react-native
description: Golden path — Mobile/React Native (Expo) (B164). A mobile CLIENT, not an HTTP service: no /health /ready /metrics /hello, no Dockerfile, no run-to-completion Job. Adapted contract: the app skeleton bundles + builds; a jest-expo + @testing-library/react-native test asserts the <Hello/> component renders the known payload `hello, weyland`; a selfcheck deliberately-failing test; a headless bundle smoke via `expo export --platform web`.
